description: This file declares functions and structures related to managing block sources in a reftable system, including reading, closing, releasing, and creating in-memory block sources.

methods.name: block_source_close
methods.description: Closes the block source and releases associated resources.

methods.name: block_source_read_data
methods.description: Reads a specified amount of data from the block source at a given offset.

methods.name: block_source_size
methods.description: Returns the total size of the underlying resource managed by the block source.

methods.name: block_source_release_data
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a block of data.

methods.name: block_source_from_buf
methods.description: Creates an in-memory block source for reading reftables from a buffer.
